svg.text: ctc backend today (a244268): one Python daemon, one Postgres, Redis as cache + streams
ctc daemon: one uvicorn process, one asyncio loop (src/ctc/server/app.py)
hybrid.search: dense RAM + keyword SQL, RRF, rerank, gate
bundle.decide: steps, agent, difficulty, model tier
ingestion, memory, ai, graph, runner: ~380 SQL call sites
hot path and background work share this loop and the 5-connection pool
L2 cache: emb, bundle, sem (FT KNN), ovr, sess, key
sessions, events, decisions, memories, jobs, history_files,
Model servers and agents (docker compose / host)
1. UserPromptSubmit: curl to the unix socket; reply within 140 ms or empty (hot)
4. route(): bundle cache, embed, blend, semantic cache, search, decide (hot)
5. emb:/bundle:/sem: lookups and writes, 20 ms timeout, fail open (hot)
6. embed query + rerank top 20 over HTTP keep-alive (hot)
7. XADD ctc:writes session / decision / event / followed (hot, non-blocking)
8. writer batches the stream into Postgres (cold)
9. CLI and hooks submit jobs: jobs row + ctc:jobs id (cold)
10. workflow runner: claude -p per node in a git worktree (cold)
11. jobs: enrich/extract/distill call llama-server; index embeds (cold)
12. ctc:inval pub/sub: every worker drops L1 and reloads the catalog (cold)
13. domain SQL: keyword candidates, overrides, recall, CRUD, jobs, runs (both)
